text: Clearstroat Hi, um I'm calling because I'd like to exchange some items I recently purchased. A water bottle and a desk lamp, specifically.
I'd be happy to help you exchange your water bottle and desk lamp.
Could you please authenticate yourself by providing your email address or your first name, last name, and zip code?
Sure, my name is May Kovax and I live in Zipcode 2.
I couldn't find your account with that information.
Could you please spell your first name letter by letter, then your last name letter by letter, and say your zip code digit by digit?
Speaking slowly, first name M E E I I, last name K-O-V-A-C-CS, zip code 28236.
I still can't find your account.
Could you please provide your email address instead?
Oh, um, I'm not sure I remember my email address off the top of my head. Is there anything else I can provide to help locate my account?
Could you please say your zip code digit by digit one more time to make sure it's correct?
Speaking clearly. Sure, it's two eight two three six.
Do you have an order number for the items you'd like to exchange?
That would help me locate your account.
Hmm, I don't have my order number with me right now. I don't remember it off the top of my head, sorry.
Could you please spell your first name one letter at a time?
Pause, then spell your last name one letter at a time.
First name M E I P.
Pause us last name K O V A C S.
I found your order with a desk lamp and water bottle.
Which desk clamp variant would you like to exchange to and which water bottle variant would you like?
For the water bottle, I'd like a bigger one.
For the desk lamp, I'd like a less bright variant.
My preference is AC adapter, then battery, then USB.
